input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

This scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 不知道如果：不知道这把花对你的身体好不好，An embedded yes/no question after 不知道 uses an A-not-A form, not 如果. [rule: a_not_a_question]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看如果：看这把花毒不毒，After 看 in this pattern, the following part must be a direct A-not-A question; 如果 is not used before it. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，When the uncertainty is between two named alternatives, use 是……还是……; 吃不吃 asks whether he ate at all rather than which plant he ate. [rule: a_not_a_question]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 花：这种花，The bare noun can mean flowers in general rather than the flower he has just found; use a clear noun phrase to refer back to that specific flower. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他：∅，The embedded subject is the same person as 神农 in the same sentence, so use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 如果 cannot introduce the embedded yes/no question after 不知道, but the correction still leaves the contextually inappropriate 你的身体.
看 takes the direct alternative question 毒不毒 here, not 如果毒不毒.
The intended meaning is whether Shennong should eat it, so 要不要吃 is needed; 是……还是…… changes the meaning to identifying which plant he ate.
花 can be understood generically, whereas 这种花 clearly refers back to the particular flower just found.
他 is acceptable in this embedded clause after the recent mention of 神农; deleting it is optional rather than a required correction, and the remaining sentence still has the separate 吃不吃 problem.
